governance.title: Human governance and delegated delivery
governance.description: The owner sets scope. The lead defines and delegates tasks. Children return changes and evidence. Checks and integration produce a reviewable result.
steps: Purpose, priorities, rights and external commitments
Plan the task and write bounded child assignments
Allocated files, findings, tests and evidence
Resolve findings and record accepted outcome

request.title: A question becomes a governed result
request.description: Client intent becomes structured arguments. Runtime validation, policy and bounded deterministic execution precede a result and its inspectable evidence.
steps: A person or their AI chooses a named operation
Check fields, types, bounds and supported protocol
Admit only an allowed operation and resource
Resolve, query or inspect within the fixed boundary
Return plain text, structured output and a receipt

evidence.title: From retained evidence to a public account
evidence.description: Sources are preserved and verified. Private analysis links claims to sources. An approved public projection produces the reader, PDF and evidence index.
steps: Source revisions, observations, reviews and tool events
Retain permitted content; record exclusions and gaps
Deduplicate, link decisions and reconcile counts
Clear claims, excerpts, rights and aggregate metrics
Narrative, learning path, PDF and evidence index

learning.title: The learning route
learning.description: Learn purpose and catalogue, then contracts and policy, then execution and evidence, then verification and publication, and finally delegation and improvement.
steps: Catalogue, OKF, sources, rights and limitations
MCP, schemas, contracts, policy and lifecycle
Threats, tests, scans, provenance and rollback
Agents, human governance, model changes and review

agent-lineage.title: Observed delegation depth
agent-lineage.description: The selected historical generation has one root, 586 first-level children, 432 second-level descendants and 24 third-level descendants. Counts are totals at each depth, not simultaneous workers.
steps: Lead task context at depth zero
Total task threads at depth one
Total task threads at depth two
Total task threads at depth three
Historical population; simultaneous activity is unknown

contracts.title: A contract becomes a test
contracts.description: A requirement defines accepted input and output. A valid fixture exercises the intended path. Hostile variants test rejection. Runtime validation enforces the contract for real callers.
steps: Only a named, bounded read-only operation is allowed
Define required fields, limits, result and error shapes
Check the intended input and complete output
Unknown fields, oversized values and forbidden targets
Every caller is checked at the executable boundary

assurance.title: Questions asked by assurance
assurance.description: Tests, security analysis, reproducible builds and provenance supply different evidence. The acceptance gate evaluates the named evidence and its limits.
steps: Does the implementation behave as the contract requires?
Which known dangerous patterns or components remain?
Do identified inputs produce the expected artefact bytes?
Which source and process produced this result?
Does the required evidence justify this particular claim?

improvement.title: A measured improvement stage
improvement.description: Start with the reviewed baseline. Fix observable defects, remove repeated ordinary work, extract modules, verify preserved invariants and compare measurements.
steps: Behaviour, test inventory, time, memory and bytes read
Cancellation, readiness and retained failure evidence
Build once for tests; retain independent derivation
Small modules with stable contracts and output bytes
Verify behaviour and measure the actual improvement
